This is an analysis of the Operations data of a volunteering activities in a Non-profit.

We are tasked to determine the contributing factors of delays in execution of tasks and suggest remedies.Also teams that are efficient would need to be rewarded and hailed to encourage more efficiency
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


## Install packages required
```{r mtcars}

library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

```


## Get dataset into R: CSV and TSV
```{r}
ops_data <- read_csv("data/operations_data.csv")


```


## 1. Explore the ops_data set
```{r}

names(ops_data) # column names
str(ops_data) # shows structure of the columns in  dataset  
visdat::vis_dat(ops_data) # checks the data types visually
dim(ops_data) #shows the size of the ops_data set
summary(ops_data) # shows summary statistics of the dataset  

unique(ops_data$volunteer_id) # check whether values in this column are unique

```
Observation:
1. The ops_data set has information about volunteers. The dataset has 7 columns and 100 records.
2. The volunteer_id has unique records of each volunteers identification
2. There is 1 character column and 6 numeric columns


## 2. Viewing the distribution of the numeric columns
```{r}

hist(ops_data$recruitment_days)
hist(ops_data$onboarding_days)
hist(ops_data$tasks_assigned)
hist(ops_data$tasks_completed)
hist(ops_data$project_delay_days)


unique(ops_data$team)
View(ops_data)

```



## 3. Cleaning and Data Wrangling
```{r}
visdat::vis_miss(ops_data) # checks for missing values

 
ops_data_max <- ops_data %>%
select(-volunteer_id) %>% 
group_by(team) %>% 
summarise(max_recruitment=max(recruitment_days),max_onboarding=max(onboarding_days),
max_tasks_assigned=max(tasks_assigned), max_tasks_completed=max(tasks_completed),  max_project_delay_days=max(project_delay_days))


ops_data_min <- ops_data %>%
select(-volunteer_id) %>% 
group_by(team) %>% 
summarise(min_recruitment=min(recruitment_days), min_onboarding=min(onboarding_days),
min_tasks_assigned=min(tasks_assigned), min_tasks_completed=min(tasks_completed), min_project_delay_days= min(project_delay_days))

write_csv(ops_data, "my_new_data.csv")

```
Observation:
1. There are no missing values
2. 


## 4. Analysis and Insights
```{r}

ops_data_avg <- ops_data %>%
select(-volunteer_id) %>% 
group_by(team) %>% 
summarise(avg_recruitment=mean(recruitment_days), avg_onboarding=mean(onboarding_days),
avg_tasks_assigned=mean(tasks_assigned), avg_tasks_completed=mean(tasks_completed),  avg_project_delay_days= mean(project_delay_days))
```



## 5. Including Plots and visualisations
Embedding Bar plot showing the average number of days for Team
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
ops_data_long <- ops_data_avg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      avg_recruitment,
      avg_onboarding,
      avg_tasks_assigned,
      avg_tasks_completed,
      avg_project_delay_days
    ),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "average"
  )

ggplot(ops_data_long, aes(x = team, y = average, fill = team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Performance by Team",
    x = "Team",
    y = "Average",
    fill = "Team"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "HR" = "steelblue",
      "Operations" = "orange",
      "Programs" = "forestgreen"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  

```
